propositions: The completion verifier pins the ticket store with fetch=False on the close path, causing it to read a stale local mirror of refs/heads/tickets that is arbitrarily behind the live tracker repository.

The model receives untrusted ticket context from the live store but uses show_ticket to read from a pinned stale snapshot, creating disagreement between the two halves of the gate and causing false verdicts.
A non-PASS verdict with empty findings is fabricated with a placeholder (unspecified) criterion instead of reporting "no verdict obtainable", leaving operators with no remediation path.
The fix must pin the ticket store at the live tracker's HEAD at close time by resolving the sha from .tickets-tracker, ensuring the pinned snapshot is current-at-close and immutable-by-sha.

Two independent blocked closes (wailsome-unsure-asianlion and fixable-angular-caribou) exhibited staleness symptoms: the first saw comments: [] and status: open falsely; the second searched for evidence anchors that were invisible in the stale pin.
